about: This page is React (src/pages/storyboard/StoryboardPage.jsx). tools/split-map.js stops generating it, drops the legacy functions below, and fails if anything left still calls them. loadStoryboard is called from all over core (after a regenerate, refine, pick or send) and is registered on window by the page.
